statement: Create new content in cache file handling with "Add layer"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it. Variant: operator cachefile.layer_add.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in cache file handling with "Move layer"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Create new content in cache file handling with "Add layer"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it. Variant: operator cachefile.layer_remove.

Bring content into the document in cache file handling with "Open Cache File"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in cache file handling with "Refresh Archive"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
